description: Three Kings Parade Route 2023 is a dataset listed in Valencia open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ayuntamiento de València. Tour of the Three Kings parade in Valencia in January 2023. Divided into the arrival of the kings by catamaran, the tour of the kings from the port to the starting point of the parade and the tour of the parade of the Three Kings in 2023. Coverage: Valencia. The portal files it under Culture and leisure. Its keywords are Christmas. The portal shows 13 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2022-11-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-valencia-portal.
